title: Targeted

steps.title: Arrays: indexed storage
steps.summary: Arrays store items contiguously for O(1) indexing; a middle insert shifts the whole tail.

steps.title: Two Sum
steps.summary: Start of the hashing chain: complement lookup in one pass.

steps.summary: Same set idea, simplified to duplicate detection.

steps.title: Valid Anagram
steps.summary: Frequency maps instead of membership sets.

steps.title: Group Anagrams
steps.summary: Sort each word or count its letters to build a canonical key for a hash map.

steps.summary: Prefix sums plus a hash map: count earlier prefixes equal to sum minus k.

steps.title: Product of Array Except Self
steps.summary: Prefix and suffix passes without division.

steps.title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
steps.summary: Put values in a set and grow runs upward only from numbers with no predecessor.

steps.title: Top K Frequent Elements
steps.summary: Count with a hash map, then bucket by frequency or keep a size-k heap.

steps.summary: Frequency maps, indexing, and prefix sums under time pressure.

steps.title: Valid Palindrome
steps.summary: Same converging pattern on characters with cleanup first.

steps.title: Three Sum
steps.summary: Sort and fix one element, then converge two pointers for the remaining sum.

steps.title: Container With Most Water
steps.summary: Two pointers at the ends: move the shorter wall inward, tracking the best area.

steps.summary: Water above a bar is the smaller of the two side maxima minus the bar's own height.

steps.title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
steps.summary: From fixed ends to a sliding window with a membership set.

steps.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
steps.summary: Window with a letter count: shrink while length minus the top count exceeds k.

steps.title: Smallest Window Covering a Multiset
steps.summary: Expand until every needed character is covered, then contract to the smallest window.

steps.title: Sliding window check
steps.summary: Window bounds, shrink conditions, and amortised scans.

steps.title: LIFO stack

steps.title: Valid Parentheses
steps.summary: Classic bracket matcher: the foundational stack problem.

steps.title: Daily Temperatures
steps.summary: Monotonic decreasing stack of indices: pop when finding a warmer day.

steps.title: Decode String
steps.summary: Nested repeats handled with a count stack and a string stack.

steps.title: Min Stack
steps.summary: Auxiliary stack of running minima so every top and min query stays O(1).

steps.title: Widest Bar Rectangle
steps.summary: Monotonic stack of bar indices; pop to measure each bar's widest span.

steps.title: Singly linked list
steps.summary: Nodes linked by pointers: O(1) inserts at a known spot, O(n) access by position.

steps.title: Reverse Linked List
steps.summary: Start of the linked-list chain: pointer rewiring in place.

steps.title: Linked List Cycle
steps.summary: Floyd's cycle detection: same fast-slow pattern, now looking for collision.

steps.title: Middle of the Linked List
steps.summary: Fast-and-slow pointers: 2x step finds the midpoint in one pass.

steps.title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
steps.summary: Splice two ordered lists with a dummy head.

steps.title: Add Two Numbers
steps.summary: Digit-by-digit addition with carry across two lists.

steps.title: Binary search step-through
steps.summary: On sorted data each probe halves the range, so any item is found in O(log n).

steps.title: Binary Search
steps.summary: Halve the range each step, keeping the invariant that the target lies inside it.

steps.title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
steps.summary: Determine which half is sorted to preserve O(log n) elimination invariant.

steps.title: Koko Eating Bananas
steps.summary: Binary search the eating speed; the hours needed is a monotone feasibility check.

steps.title: Median of Two Arrays
steps.summary: Binary search a partition of the shorter array so both halves balance.

steps.summary: Inorder, preorder, and postorder each visit every node once in a different order.

steps.title: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
steps.summary: Start of the tree chain: simplest recursive depth.

steps.title: Invert Binary Tree
steps.summary: Swap left and right subtrees recursively.

steps.title: Validate Binary Search Tree
steps.summary: Pass valid ranges down the recursion: left < node < right.

steps.title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST
steps.summary: Inorder traversal visits nodes in ascending order; stop at k.

steps.title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
steps.summary: Split point in the tree where targets fall in different subtrees.

steps.title: Trees & BST check
steps.summary: Traversals, BST ordering, and height-based recursions.

steps.title: Binary heap
steps.summary: A complete tree kept in array form: the root holds the min or max, sift to repair.

steps.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
steps.summary: Maintain a min-heap of size k to find the kth largest element in O(n log k).

steps.summary: Two heaps, max for the lower half and min for the upper, rebalanced to stay within one.

steps.title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
steps.summary: Backtrack through each digit's choices, undoing a choice before trying the next.

steps.title: Subsets
steps.summary: Bit choices or backtracking enumerate every subset without repeating a combination.

steps.title: Course Schedule

steps.title: Course Schedule II
steps.summary: Return the actual valid ordering, not just cycle detection.

steps.title: Word Ladder
steps.summary: BFS over one-letter mutations; the first time the target appears is the shortest chain.

steps.title: Cheapest Flights Within K Stops
steps.summary: BFS by hop count over a price table, relaxing each route up to k stops.

steps.title: Graphs check
steps.summary: BFS, DFS, topological order, and connectivity questions.

steps.title: Recursion tree
steps.summary: Draw every call as a node to see the branching that sets the time complexity.

steps.title: Climbing Stairs
steps.summary: Start of DP chain: Fibonacci recurrence with two variables.

steps.title: House Robber

steps.title: Maximum Subarray
steps.summary: Kadane's algorithm: extend current subarray or start fresh at each index.

steps.title: Coin Change
steps.summary: Unbounded knapsack: min coins to make amount across all denominations.

steps.title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
steps.summary: Quadratic DP over earlier smaller elements; patience piles reach n log n.

steps.title: Edit Distance
steps.summary: Grid DP over prefixes with insert, delete, and replace costs.

steps.title: Targeted DP check
steps.summary: Recurrence relations, memoization bounds, and subproblem structure.

steps.title: Gas Station

steps.title: Jump Game II

steps.title: Maximum Number of Events That Can Be Attended
steps.summary: Sort by end time and take every event starting after the last attended end.

steps.title: Merge Intervals
steps.summary: Sort by start, then sweep and merge overlaps in one pass.

steps.title: Spiral Matrix
steps.summary: Four boundaries moving inward as each edge is traversed.

steps.title: Rotate Image
steps.summary: Transpose across the main diagonal, then mirror every row horizontally.

steps.title: Single Number

steps.title: Largest Number
steps.summary: Sort with a comparator that puts the larger concatenation first.

steps.title: LRU Cache
steps.summary: Hash map plus doubly linked list: move each hit to the front and evict the tail.
